title: PhaseManifest
description: Per-phase shallow index of every artifact that belongs to one project phase, living at intracardiac-platform/project/phases/phase_X/manifest.json. Schema version 1. Entries are POINTERS, not content: each carries only id + path + producer + relationship references (+ optional usage_tag / usage_notes / download_url). Everything else (title, description, layout, metrics, ...) lives inside the standalone file the entry points at. Banks are split by CONTENT/ROLE into two sections: `egm_banks` holds every bank of EGM traces (training tbank_, pretraining ptbank_, and prediction lpred_/upred_ banks — a prediction bank is just an EGM bank whose entry also fills `model` + `source_bank`), and `noise_banks` holds nbank_ banks of additive noise, which differ in both content and role. Relationship field names (trained_on_bank, produced_model, source_bank, consumes_banks, ...) are chosen to map 1:1 onto future provenance-graph edge types. egm-studio is the canonical curator; scripts/validate_manifest.py is the scan-and-validate safety net. Phase membership is recorded here — the artifacts it points at do not themselves declare which phase they belong to. See intracardiac-platform/project/cross_artifact_linkage_design.md sections 3 and 8.

schema_version.description: Schema version. Consumers MUST refuse unknown major versions. Pre-1.0 of egm-contracts: enum-of-one per project/schema_evolution.md.

phase.description: Project science-phase number this manifest indexes (e.g. 1.5, 2, 5). Numeric; the on-disk folder uses an underscore form (phase_1_5).

phase_summary.description: One-paragraph free-text description of what this phase is about. For human readability when opening the file cold.

egm_banks.description: Banks of EGM traces — training (tbank_), pretraining (ptbank_), and prediction (lpred_ labeled / upred_ unlabeled) banks. The id prefix tells the role; a prediction bank is an entry that also fills `model` + `source_bank`. All flow through the ClassifierBank structure downstream.

noise_banks.description: Noise banks (nbank_) — quiet segments the synthetic mixer ADDS to EGM data. Separate from egm_banks because the content (noise, not EGM) and role (additive source, not classified data) differ.

observations.description: Observations (obs_ prefix) — a recorded discovery, optionally pinning specific traces.

figures.description: Figure specs (fig_ prefix) — the spec file is the artifact; the rendered image is gitignored build output.

papers.description: Papers (paper_ prefix) that this phase contributes to.

UsageTag.description: Standardized usage vocabulary for observations + figures. See cross_artifact_linkage_design.md section 8. 'in_paper_main' / 'in_paper_supplementary' are figures-only; 'informed_paper' is observations-only; the rest apply to both.

EgmBankEntry.title: EgmBankEntry
EgmBankEntry.description: Manifest pointer to a bank of EGM traces (training / pretraining / prediction). The id prefix encodes the role. `model` + `source_bank` are filled only for prediction banks (lpred_ / upred_); training and pretraining banks omit them.

path.description: Path to the bank file, relative to the meta repo (or absolute).

produced_by_version.description: Producer version that wrote the artifact (e.g. v0.2.0).

model.description: Prediction banks only: the model that produced the predictions (future edge EVALUATED_BY).

source_bank.description: Prediction banks only: the EGM bank the predictions were computed on (future edge REFERENCES_SOURCE).

download_url.description: OPTIONAL. GitHub Release asset URL, filled at phase-release time (not write time).

NoiseBankEntry.title: NoiseBankEntry
NoiseBankEntry.description: Manifest pointer to a noise bank (nbank_). No model / source_bank — noise banks are an additive source, never classified.

TrainingRunEntry.title: TrainingRunEntry
TrainingRunEntry.description: Manifest pointer to a training run record (run.json).

trained_on_bank.description: Relationship: run -> training bank (future edge TRAINED_ON).

ModelEntry.title: ModelEntry
ModelEntry.description: Manifest pointer to an exported model.

trained_from_run.description: Relationship: model -> run (future edge TRAINED_FROM, inverse of PRODUCED).

ObservationEntry.title: ObservationEntry
ObservationEntry.description: Manifest pointer to an observation file.

usage_tag.description: OPTIONAL day-to-day; REQUIRED at release-gate. For observations, 'informed_paper' marks one that informed a paper claim.

FigureEntry.title: FigureEntry
FigureEntry.description: Manifest pointer to a figure spec file.

consumes_banks.description: Relationship: figure -> banks it visualizes (future edge VISUALIZES). May reference egm_banks and/or noise_banks.

consumes_observations.description: Relationship: figure -> observations it illustrates (future edge BUILDS_ON).

usage_tag.description: OPTIONAL day-to-day; REQUIRED at release-gate. For figures, 'in_paper_main' / 'in_paper_supplementary' place it in the paper.

PaperEntry.title: PaperEntry
PaperEntry.description: Manifest pointer to a paper directory in intracardiac-papers.

produced_by_version.description: The paper repo isn't version-tagged like the libraries; 'latest' is acceptable.
